capabilities: Draw shapes, arrows, text and self-numbering markers on images
Pixelate, blur or cover sensitive areas with a solid block
Crop, rotate, flip and adjust brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth and sharpness
Browse the images of a note or folder as a gallery with thumbnails
Save edits back to the vault as PNG, JPG or WebP, overwriting or as a copy
disambiguation: Not only markup: it is a full image editor that also crops, rotates, adjusts colors and converts file formats.
extras: Overwriting is permanent unless File Recovery, Obsidian Sync, git or another backup exists; saving re-encodes the image and drops EXIF metadata; images over 16 megapixels are refused. Not yet in the community plugin list, so install via BRAT or manually.
motivation: The author wanted quick image fixes — cropping a taskbar, turning a photo upright, pointing at a button, hiding a password — to happen without breaking the note-taking flow.
problem: Fixing a screenshot or photo in a note means leaving Obsidian for a separate image editor, then exporting and re-embedding the file.

relations.evidence: With BRAT: add VBV11/photomark-plus in the BRAT plugin.

summary: In-note image editor that crops, rotates, adjusts, annotates and pixelates images, then saves them back into the vault.
